action: Request a private, one-on-one sit-down with Patricia Hawkins — not a phone call, an in-person meeting. Frame it as a GM operational briefing: floor plan financing concerns, staffing continuity, Q2 inventory strategy. But the real agenda is to get her to tell me, without a room full of people watching, what the actual plan is for this store. Is Regional Auto Group holding Millfield? Is there a timeline I need to know? I have 4 dependents and I am not going to manage this floor blind for another tick.
